name: Anne Celestino
bio:
Born in Recife, at around 12 years old Anne  recognized herself as trans.  Realizing the importance of representation, and how it can positively impact other people's lives, combined with her fascination with theater, she decided to become an actress.  Trans causes and art began to be part of her life in 2016 through her YouTube channel, “Transtornada" and her Instagram @annemotareal where she is a content creator. Her professional journey as an actress began with her starring role in the film "Alice Júnior", winning Best Actress at the 52nd Brasília Festival and Best Performance at the 2019 Mix Festival. In addition to Honorable Mention for best performance at the IMAGE+NATION Festival Film LGBTQUEER Montreal 2020 and Female Revelation at the Guarani Brazilian Cinema Awards 2021. Other audiovisual works followed, such as “Teenage Kiss”, "Da Ponte Pra Lá", "Evidências do Amor", and once again as the protagonist in “Alice Júnior 2: Férias De Verão”.

In addition to her academic dedication to studying  theater acting at the CIT Course - SESC PIEDADE, she studied at the Wolf Maya acting school and complements her scenic education with free courses.
